about:
AirTrack Electronics Corporation is a contract electronics manufacturer based in Meridian, Idaho, near Boise. The company was founded in 2001 and has been providing contract manufacturing services for electronic and electro-mechanical devices since its inception.

The company offers a range of assembly and integration services, including electronic assembly, assembly modifications, rework, and updating, as well as mechanical assembly involving fasteners, adhesives, wire harnesses, and potting. Additional capabilities encompass programming, testing, packaging, and prototype development. AirTrack describes itself as small and nimble, focusing on quick-turn projects and welcoming prototype work alongside matured production runs.

AirTrack serves inventors, entrepreneurs, engineers, and businesses seeking to launch electronic products. The company works with customers from early-stage prototyping through to established production, though specific industry sectors or named clients are not disclosed in its public materials.

AirTrack emphasizes its small size as an advantage, stating that it allows exceptional service and that every customer is valued. The company highlights quick turnaround as a specialty, along with flexibility, simplicity, and genuine care for its customers. Short lead times and the ability to handle special requirements are also noted as differentiators.
